title: Concept: Git dependency pinned through a semver fragment
description: package.json declares a git dependency whose fragment asks npm to resolve a semver range instead of committing to one tree, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The install resolves the range against the remote's tags at fetch time, so the compiled tree can move without a manifest change and without a lockfile review.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The install resolves the range against the remote's tags at fetch time, so the compiled tree can move without a manifest change and without a lockfile review.
